problem_text: Let k be a fixed even positive integer, N is the product of k distinct primes p_1,...,p_k, a,b are two positive integers, a,b<=N. Denote S_1={d | d|N, a<=d<=b, d has even number of prime factors}, S_2={d | d|N, a<=d<=b, d has odd number of prime factors}. Prove: |S_1|-|S_2|<=C(k,k/2).
solution_text:
Key idea: Express |S_1|-|S_2| as a sum of consecutive coefficients of the generating polynomial P(x)=prod_{i=1}^k (1-x^{p_i}), then prove by induction on k that any such sum is bounded by binom(k, floor(k/2)).

Proof: Each divisor d of N corresponds to a subset S of [k], with d=prod_{i in S} p_i and omega(d)=|S|. The polynomial P(x)=prod_{i=1}^k (1-x^{p_i}) has coefficient (-1)^{|S|} at x^d for each divisor d. Therefore |S_1|-|S_2| = sum_{n=a}^{b} [x^n] P(x), a sum of consecutive coefficients.

Induction on k: Base case k=0: P(x)=1, any consecutive coefficient sum is at most 1 = binom(0,0).

Inductive step: Let Q(x)=prod_{i=1}^{k-1} (1-x^{p_i}), so P(x)=Q(x)(1-x^{p_k}). Then [x^n]P = [x^n]Q - [x^{n-p_k}]Q, so sum_{n=a}^b [x^n]P = sum_{n=a}^b [x^n]Q - sum_{n=a-p_k}^{b-p_k} [x^n]Q. Both terms are consecutive coefficient sums of Q, each bounded by binom(k-1, floor((k-1)/2)) by induction.

Therefore |sum| <= 2*binom(k-1, floor((k-1)/2)). When k is even, floor((k-1)/2)=k/2-1, and binom(k-1,k/2-1)=binom(k-1,k/2), so 2*binom(k-1,k/2-1) = binom(k-1,k/2-1)+binom(k-1,k/2) = binom(k,k/2) by Pascal's identity. The bound is tight when k is even.
solution_summary: 将|S_1|-|S_2|重构为生成多项式P(x)=∏(1-x^{p_i})的连续系数和，对k归纳：P=Q(1-x^{p_k})将和分解为Q的两个连续系数和之差，每个≤C(k-1,⌊(k-1)/2⌋)，Pascal恒等式2·C(k-1,k/2-1)=C(k,k/2)在k为偶时精确闭合。

rounds.question: 描述这道题的结构：N的约数与[1,k]的子集有什么对应关系？|S_1|-|S_2|在代数上是什么？
rounds.expected_answer: N的每个约数d对应子集S⊆[k]，ω(d)=|S|。|S_1|-|S_2|=Σ_{d|N,a≤d≤b}(-1)^{ω(d)}是一个带符号交替的求和，区间[a,b]选取了部分约数。目标是证明这个和≤C(k,k/2)。

rounds.question: 列出所有你能想到的逼近这个问题的方法
rounds.expected_answer: 直接计数法、Möbius函数、生成函数/多项式方法、归纳法、Sperner定理、对称链分解、Bonferroni不等式、组合恒等式等

rounds.question: 试用直接计数法：按素因子个数j分组，n_j=[a,b]中恰有j个素因子的约数个数，能否得到C(k,k/2)的界？
rounds.expected_answer: 直接计数给出|S_1|-|S_2|≤Σn_j≤2^k，远大于C(k,k/2)≈2^k/√(πk/2)。问题在于没有利用交替符号的抵消结构和区间约束。

rounds.question: 构造一个生成多项式P(x)，使其系数恰好为(-1)^{ω(d)}。什么样的多项式满足这个性质？
rounds.expected_answer: P(x)=∏_{i=1}^k(1-x^{p_i})。展开后x^d的系数恰为(-1)^{|S|}，其中d=∏_{i∈S}p_i。因此|S_1|-|S_2|=Σ_{n=a}^b [x^n]P(x)，即P(x)在[a,b]上的连续系数和。

rounds.question: 现在你有P(x)=∏(1-x^{p_i})，如何利用其乘积结构对连续系数和进行归纳？
rounds.expected_answer: 设Q(x)=∏_{i<k}(1-x^{p_i})，则P=Q(1-x^{p_k})。[x^n]P=[x^n]Q-[x^{n-p_k}]Q。因此Σ_{n=a}^b[x^n]P = Σ_{n=a}^b[x^n]Q - Σ_{n=a-p_k}^{b-p_k}[x^n]Q，即Q的两个连续系数和之差。

rounds.question: 对Q应用归纳假设，每个连续系数和≤C(k-1,⌊(k-1)/2⌋)。如何用Pascal恒等式得到C(k,k/2)？
验证奠基情形(k=0)，检查等号成立的条件，完成证明
rounds.expected_answer: k=0: P(x)=1，连续系数和≤1=C(0,0)✓。k为偶时Pascal恒等式取等，界是紧的。完整证明：重构→归纳→Pascal恒等式，三步完成。
